Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr.P Sarma
Advocate for the Respondent :
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi
 Order

Heard Shri O.P. Bhati, learned counsel for the petitioners, who have filed this application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C with a prayer for quashing of Complaint Case No. 2184c of 2001 pending in the Court of the Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (M).
The aforesaid case was instituted by the Food Inspector under the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

This Court while issuing notice had passed an interim order directing that Page No.# 3/3 further proceedings of the impugned case shall remain suspended and the said interim order is being continued from time to time.
Also heard Shri R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam.
Admit for hearing.
Call for the records.
Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 24 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91899888/

2 At this stage, it is clarified that though the respondent no. 2 was made party by name, the complaint was lodged by the respondent no. 2 in its official capacity as Food Inspector and therefore, both the respondents can be represented by the learned Add. Public Prosecutor, Assam.
Since the case is of the year 2015, Registry to list this case for hearing in the 3rd week of April, 2022.
Interim order passed earlier to continue till the disposal of this case.
